headline: American Electric Power (AEP) Appoints David S. Marriott And Charles J. Meyers To Board
summary: American Electric Power Company (NasdaqGS:AEP) has appointed David S. Marriott and Charles J. Meyers as new independent directors to its Board of Directors. The appointments add leadership experience from outside industries to AEP's boardroom. These changes expand the Board's mix of operational and governance backgrounds.
